name: Arbaclofen placarbil
summary: Arbaclofen placarbil, also known as XP19986, is a prodrug of R-baclofen. Arbaclofen placarbil possesses more favorable pharmacokinetic profile than baclofen, with less fluctuations in plasma drug levels.

pharmacology.text: Arbaclofen placarbil, also known as XP19986, is a prodrug of R-baclofen.

uses.text: It was being developed as a potential treatment for patients with GERD and spasticity due to multiple sclerosis; however, in May 2013, XenoPort announced the termination of development because of unsuccessful results in phase III clinical trials. It is being developed as a medication to treat alcohol use disorder. It is also studied as a potential therapy for some people with autism.

sideEffects.en: Because it releases baclofen, its effects are those of baclofen: drowsiness, dizziness, weakness, nausea and headache. Stopping baclofen suddenly after regular use can cause serious withdrawal, with agitation, hallucinations and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它會釋出巴可芬，其反應就是巴可芬的反應：嗜睡、頭暈、無力、噁心與頭痛。規律使用後突然停用巴可芬可能造成嚴重戒斷，出現躁動、幻覺與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它会发布巴可芬，其反应就是巴可芬的反应：嗜睡、头晕、无力、恶心与头痛。规律使用后突然停用巴可芬可能造成严重戒断，出现躁动、幻觉与癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a prodrug built so that it is absorbed further along the gut than baclofen itself, which gives steadier levels in the blood. Its development was stopped in 2013.
fact.zh: 它是設計成比巴可芬本身在腸道更後段被吸收的前驅藥，因此血中濃度較為穩定。它的開發於 2013 年中止。
fact.zhHans: 它是设计成比巴可芬本身在肠道更后段被吸收的前驱药，因此血中浓度较为稳定。它的开发于 2013 年中止。
